# Display v2 and the v1 Adapter Requirements Quality Checklist: Versioned Plug-in ABIs (spec 037)

**Purpose**: Are the v2 interface, the confined v1 adapter, copy semantics, lifetime and threading rules complete and unambiguous?
**Created**: 2026-10-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) (plan.md, research.md, data-model.md, contracts/ read for cross-checks)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Display v2 interface

- [x] CHK001 Is the per-display context handle's scope defined (what it identifies, who owns it, validity) beyond "a handle the host passes to every entry point"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK002 Are "the two matrices drivers use" named (spec says two plus the screen matrix; contract lists Nl, NP, screen)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK003 Are string-array and multi-valued parameter semantics stated (contract exposes only the first string element)? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK004 Is "per-channel quantization when it differs from the display default" defined (compared to what, how represented)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK005 Are descriptor consistency rules measurable: offsets and counts sum to the per-tile sample count, no overlap, deterministic order? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016, §US3-3]
- [x] CHK006 Are zero-channel and depth-only (`z`-only) displays given requirements beyond the Edge Cases sentence (descriptor count, sample count, driver obligations)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK007 Is the defaulting rule for quantize/dither (depth defaults only for mode exactly `z`) a stated requirement rather than only a contract note? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK008 Is the replacement of `displayRawData` removal and the retention of `RtDisplayRawDataFunction` in ri.h consistent with FR-019's "one definition per interface"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019; research Q5]
- [x] CHK009 Is it stated that `RiCustomDisplay` callbacks are served by the v1 adapter (FR-019 says only "converts explicitly")? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]

## Threading, lifetime, unload

- [x] CHK010 Is the meaning of start failure (no `data`, no `finish`, no unload dependency) a spec requirement? FR-017 covers only `data` returning false. [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK011 Is the success/failure vocabulary consistent ("false return" in the spec vs `OrStatus` in the contract)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK012 Does the spec state whether different displays of one module may run `data` concurrently and who protects module-wide state (contract §4.7 only)? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK013 Is the in-flight rule defined for `data` calls that arrive after a sibling thread saw the failure (must return quickly, host starts no new call)? [Gap, Spec §US3-4, §FR-018]
- [x] CHK014 Do "finish called exactly once per started display" (FR-017) and "unload only after finish" (FR-018) hold for a v1 driver whose failing `data` has the old "no finish afterwards" contract? [Conflict, Spec §FR-017, §FR-018; contracts/display-v1-adapter.md §3.4]
- [x] CHK015 Is the snapshot/descriptor lifetime ("from start until finish returns") consistent with the Assumption that in-tree drivers read only inside `start`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK016 Is the "defined point" for releasing never-disabled modules stated in the requirement (after finish, in endDisplays) and does it cover displays that failed to start or were never started? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-018, §FR-035]
- [x] CHK017 Are multi-frame renders covered (driver reloaded per frame, version-check caching, unload/reload at frame boundaries)? [Gap, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK018 Are paths with no plug-in (`tsm`, network client) explicitly out of the contract? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]

## v1 adapter and copies-only

- [x] CHK019 Is "copies only" stated as a testable property (a v1 driver's writes affect no renderer-core state and no other display's copies)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006, §SC-013]
- [x] CHK020 Is the adapter's lookup behaviour outside `start` (not-found, log once per display) specified in a requirement, including calls from other threads? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §FR-020, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK021 Does the spec say whether v1 drivers get serialised `data` calls (the contract serialises with a per-display mutex; the spec's FR-017 describes concurrent `data`)? [Gap, Spec §FR-017; research Q8]
- [x] CHK022 Is "confined to one module and one place in the loader" measurable (named files, mechanical no-cast / no-v1-type check)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK023 Is the adapter's thread-local binding explicitly reconciled with FR-014 ("no global current display") in the spec rather than only in contracts/research? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-014]
- [x] CHK024 Are behaviour differences between native v1 and adapted v1 (driver-written effects lost; legacy `displayRawData` ignored) listed as intended changes in the requirements? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications Q4]
- [x] CHK025 Is the rejection of display MAJORs other than 1 and 2 testable with named cases (3, 0, garbage)? [Coverage, Spec §SC-013]
- [x] CHK026 Are in-tree driver migrations (FR-021) tied to "exact" pixel identity for a defined scene set, including which AOV/deterministic scenes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021, §SC-004]
